name: Big Brother
source: Tsukiko has a brother that is always locked up in the basement and sometimes she could hear strange noises coming from there. One day Tsukikos friend comes over and everything goes wrong. TWs: Torture, Intestines
translation: 月子有一个哥哥，总是被锁在地下室里，有时她会听到那里传来奇怪的声音。有一天，月子的朋友过来了，一切都出了问题。TWs：酷刑、肠子
